business.name: Courtyard by Marriott New Orleans Near the French Quarter

ranking.name: Courtyard by Marriott New Orleans Near the French Quarter

text.text_excerpt: In retrospect, this Courtyard was overall a very good hotel. It's located right on the dividing line between the Central Business District and The French Quarter. What that means is that you could essentially spend your entire trip here and never need a car. The Quarter, the Fauborg Marigny, and the French Market are all in easy walking distance. Not only that, the hotel is right across from a stop for the St Charles Avenue Streetcar. So, for $1.25, you can ride the streetcar uptown and explore the Garden District and the Tulane area. If you're driving in, the bad part is that parking is scarce in the CBD, so you will be paying $30 per day for valet parking. I had a bad experience here on...

The hotel lobby was nice with a nice sitting/visiting area. The staff were all professional and courteous upon check in. There is a food service/cafe in the lobby but we did not eat there. The room was a decent size. It was clean and fresh. There was no vent or bathtub in the bathroom. This hotel is located in the Downtown Area, but still convenient to Bourbon, Canal, and the "French Quarter." It was not a far walk. They offer valet parking for $29 per day after tax or you can park on the street. We could never find an open parking place so it was worth the charge to valet. Overall, this was a nice hotel. We only stayed one evening, but everything we encountered was satisfactory. We would...

Stayed here for 5 nights and was pleasantly surprised. From the outside, I didnt think much of the hotel (the online pictures show its best angle, not really what you notice in real life). But inside it had a modern look. Service was polite and helpful. My favourite line from hotel staff is 'we will take care of it'. Yes, thank you Marriot for doing just that. Including helping me get change, giving directions and helping us get a taxi really quickly. There is free wifi throughout the hotel. Our room was well cleaned every day.
